name: Egg Hatcher
description: Incubates Cobbreeding Pokemon eggs from the pasture's egg slot and nearby chests, hatching them one at a time. Higher proficiency = faster incubation.

prof1Speed.tooltip: Tick simulations per cycle at Proficiency 1. 1.0 = same as vanilla Cobbreeding (player carrying the egg).

prof2Speed.tooltip: Tick simulations per cycle at Proficiency 2.

prof3Speed.label: Prof 3 ★★★☆☆ Speed
prof3Speed.tooltip: Tick simulations per cycle at Proficiency 3.

prof4Speed.label: Prof 4 ★★★★☆ Speed
prof4Speed.tooltip: Tick simulations per cycle at Proficiency 4.

prof5Speed.label: Prof 5 ★★★★★ Speed
prof5Speed.tooltip: Tick simulations per cycle at Proficiency 5 (best hatchers). Default 5× = a Chansey hatches an egg 5x faster than a vanilla player carrying it.
